answer: Randomized warm-up arrival check: new identities must send 12 requests over 30 minutes with irregular inter-arrival gaps. Regular or gale-like synchronized streams are rejected, so each clone must wait and add random delays. Requests falling in one walnut-sized slot are clustered and rejected, making mass signup pay full wait per identity. A plume-shaped long-gap tail is required, costing each fake at least 30 minutes of scheduling.
